verdict.rationale: Composio documents a 'provider' concept, described as the adapter that converts Composio tools into the native tool format a framework expects. The docs say it 'works with any AI framework' with no glue code, and an MCP route is offered as a provider-free alternative. The evidence never names which frameworks have adapters, so coverage of the specific SDKs in the story cannot be confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of named adapters for Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of those integrations.
